scope: Authorized small-sample local transcription and current-session visual inspection; not a general accuracy benchmark

source.title: Building pi in a World of Slop — Mario Zechner

vocabulary_hinted_warm_run.prompt: Pi. Terminal-Bench. Terminus. tmux. TUI framework. context handoff. Markdown. pi-ai. pi-agent-core. pi-tui. pi-coding-agent.

observed_technical_errors.reference_basis: YouTube captions and visible PI-AI slide
YouTube captions and visible PI-TUI slide

limits: No hand-corrected reference transcript; no formal WER reported
Warm run also adds vocabulary hints, so it is not an isolated speed comparison
Process RSS is not whole-system unified-memory consumption
No local small, large-v3, turbo or Parakeet inference performed

visual_inspection.extraction: FFmpeg, four sampled PNG images at fps=1/30
visual_inspection.analysis: Current model session with image input; not an installed local vision model

observations.interpretation: Leaderboard displayed as a screenshot; observations refer to the historical slide, not current rankings

roles.PI-AI: Unified LLM API, providers, streaming, tool calling and cross-provider context handoff
roles.PI-AGENT-CORE: Agent loop, tool execution, validation, event streaming and message queueing
roles.PI-CODING-AGENT: CLI, sessions, themes, extensions, skills and project context

limits: Sampled images, not continuous native-video analysis
Installed Qwen3 is text-only; no local VLM inference or new VLM weight download
